search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_0^1dx\int_{2x}^{x^2+1}f(x,y)dy$ 的积分次序为[\quad] $\int_0^1dy\int_{2y}^{y^2+1}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^2dy\int_0^{y/2}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_0^{y/2}f(x,y)dx+\int_1^2dy\int_{\sqrt{y-1}}^{y/2}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^1dy\int_0^{y/2}f(x,y)dx+\int_1^2dy\int_{\sqrt{y-1}}^{y/2}f(x,y)dx$ 解答 原式=$\int_0^1dy\int_0^{\frac{y}{2}}f(x,y)dx+\int_1^2dy\int_{\sqrt{y-1}}^{\frac{y}{2}}f(x,y)dx$。
